question: Why was the acid value of the macaw palm almond oil evaluated as a heat-transfer fluid higher than every literature value for macaw oil it was compared with?
rendered: The acid value of the macaw palm almond oil evaluated as a heat-transfer fluid was 3.44 mg KOH·g−1, which is lower than the values reported by Gonçalves (3.49 mg KOH·g−1) and substantially lower than those of Melo (12.24 mg of KOH/g) and Amaral (12.8 mg KOH·g−1).
